notes: Read session_orchestrator together with continuation_policy and SessionArtifactStore. Session-visible phase is surfaced through task_progress; kernel PhaseManager remains the phase SSOT and is bridged through canonical turn history and checkpoint state, not role-profile schema. Role object instantiation uses instantiate_role_runtime_object(InstantiateRoleRuntimeObjectCommandV1) to query roles.profile through GetRoleProfileQueryV1 and bind only profile/tool/prompt/data refs plus profile_fingerprint; RoleProfileBinding rejects any owner or profile/policy ref namespace outside roles.profile; RoleRuntimeObject also carries a refs-only RoleTurnContext, and built-in specs derive typed input, context snapshot, and task refs from RoleIdentity when an explicit turn context is not supplied; roles.runtime does not own profile or turn state. RoleTurnEnvelope rejects identity/profile role mismatches and task-market work refs outside the current turn_context.task_refs so inconsistent typed envelopes cannot enter ledger/commit boundaries. RoleTurnContext rejects typed input refs outside roles.runtime or runtime.task_market, context snapshot refs outside context.engine or roles.session, handoff refs outside factory.cognitive_runtime, and task refs outside runtime.task_market. Role asset mount tables, capability descriptors, and capability ports reject roles.runtime, role adapter/kernel/profile/session cells, and kernelone.roles paths as owners; asset mount refs also reject role-runtime and KernelOne role-template namespaces, so business assets and capabilities must be owned by their real business or platform state Cell and mounted only by public contract/ref. The KernelOne release gate scans all roles.runtime owned Python paths from cell.yaml (public/**, internal/**, role_chat.py, and role_session.py) and rejects cross-Cell polaris.cells.*.internal imports before release; it also scans polaris/kernelone/roles/** and rejects business-role filenames or Python definitions for PM, Chief Engineer, Architect, QA, and Director so KernelOne stays limited to shared types and low-level role templates. Role task-market lifecycle uses execute_role_task_market_lifecycle(ExecuteRoleTaskMarketLifecycleCommandV1) to translate role-bound claim/lease/ack/fail/requeue operations into runtime.task_market public contracts; RoleTaskMarketBinding rejects active work item and lease token refs outside runtime.task_market. Role capability invocation is latest-only: RoleCapabilityInvocation rejects payload refs outside roles.runtime or runtime.task_market and requires a 64-character hex capability fingerprint value; RoleCapabilityDecision evidence refs must point to audit.evidence; RoleCapabilityInvocationResultV1 rejects role runtime/kernel/profile/session owner cells, requires target result refs to point to the declared owner Cell, and only permits non-result payload refs from runtime typed input or task-market refs; failed capability invocation results must always report allowed=false, while capability discoverability is represented only by metadata.capability_available; after fingerprint unlock and before any target Cell public call, execute_role_capability_invocation requires invocation.payload_ref to match the runtime object current RoleTurnContext typed input ref or task refs; the KernelOne release gate enforces failed-result semantics with an AST check against public runtime code, rejecting static RoleCapabilityInvocationResultV1(ok=False, allowed=True) constructors before release; mounted ports validate role allow-lists, capability fingerprints, command contracts, and current-turn payload refs, then delegate to target Cell public APIs such as runtime.task_market PublishTaskWorkItemCommandV1 / QueryTaskMarketStatusV1, runtime.projection RuntimeProjectionQueryV1, chief_engineer.blueprint GenerateTaskBlueprintCommandV1, code_intelligence.engine VerifyAstDependencyQueryV1, factory.verification_guard VerifyCompletionCommandV1, qa.audit_verdict RunQaAuditCommandV1 / ParseTracebackFramesCommandV1 / RunVisualQaAuditCommandV1, finops.budget_guard ReserveBudgetCommandV1, and policy.workspace_guard WorkspaceWriteGuardBatchQueryV1. Chief Engineer blueprint delegation carries mounted BlueprintDatabase, ArchConstraintMemo, and DiffMapArchive refs in typed command context/result metadata so roles.runtime never owns those assets. PM critical-path evaluation derives task DAG dependency edges, failed stages, projection refs, and mounted asset refs from runtime.task_market QueryTaskMarketStatusV1 results; it does not scan scattered files or own task state. QA pytest verification requires both role_id=qa and the QA capability fingerprint before building VerifyCompletionCommandV1, so misconfigured non-QA ports are rejected without calling factory.verification_guard. QA visual audit first queries llm.control_plane CheckLlmModelCapabilityQueryV1 and requires an explicit image_input capability ref before building RunVisualQaAuditCommandV1; the required model capability comes from the mounted descriptor, payload downgrade attempts return allowed=false before model preflight, and text-only models do not invoke QA. Architect boundary validation uses policy.permission EvaluatePermissionCommandV1, policy.workspace_guard WorkspaceWriteGuardBatchQueryV1, and architect.design GenerateArchitectureDesignCommandV1 through public services; empty changed_paths are denied before permission/guard/design calls, and sandbox denials return allowed=false. Role state commit uses commit_role_state(RoleStateCommitRequest) to bind an existing roles.kernel CommitReceipt ref to factory.cognitive_runtime ValidateChangeSetCommandV1, RecordRuntimeReceiptCommandV1, and ExportHandoffPackCommandV1; successful RoleStateCommitReceipt values must include both the kernel CommitReceipt ref and at least one Cognitive Runtime receipt ref; ledger/commit/turn outcome refs must point to roles.kernel, and runtime receipt, handoff, and change-set refs must point to factory.cognitive_runtime. roles.runtime stores refs only and does not create a second ledger, change-set validator, handoff system, or receipt store. Director task execution delegates to director.execution ExecuteDirectorTaskCommandV1 via director.execution.public.service.execute_director_task while mounting only ExecutionTask, DirectorExecutionState, and DirectorEvidenceTrail refs; roles.runtime keeps result/evidence refs only. Phase 5 chain assembly uses AssembleRoleRuntimeChainCommandV1 to produce a refs-only RoleRuntimeChainEnvelope across PM, Chief Engineer, Director, QA, audit evidence, Turn Ledger, runtime receipts, handoff refs, Task Market refs, Runtime Projection refs, and per-step capability fingerprint refs without creating a second Task Market, ledger, handoff pack, receipt store, or projection. RoleRuntimeChainEnvelope rejects aggregate refs that omit step task/work-item, evidence, capability fingerprint, handoff, or runtime receipt refs; RoleRuntimeChainStepRef rejects role runtime/kernel/profile/session and KernelOne role-template owner cells, requires result_ref to point to its owner_cell, and enforces source-of-truth namespaces for task market, evidence, fingerprint, handoff, receipt, projection, and ledger refs.
